supported_facts: Reporting consistently states that investigators reconstructed 27 autonomous criminal events involving aggravated thefts and vehicle damage.
The reconstructed events are reported in central Lamezia Terme and the Sambiase area.
The investigation originated from a sequence reported during the night between 28 February and 1 March 2025.
The material reviewed does not enumerate all 27 occurrences one by one with independent time/place anchors.

event_identity_analysis.rationale: A source-supported aggregate count does not establish 27 separately resolvable canonical occurrences.

temporal_analysis.caution: Do not assign the entire reported count of 27 to the seed night unless an occurrence-level list proves that all members fall in that window.

geography_analysis.caution: A cluster-wide centre/neighbourhood label must not become one pseudo-point representing 27 events.

offence_analysis.caution: Do not assign the same offence code to every unresolved member without occurrence-level evidence.

recommended_resolution: Create one EVENT_CLUSTER record with reported_event_count=27 and preserve the 28 February-1 March window as the investigation seed occurrence window. Resolve member EVENTs only when each occurrence has independent distinguishing evidence.
